scope: Test-informed full-batch delivery and influence observation: two 21-ticket baseline runs and two revised-release runs through the production triage CLI
source_editor_surface: triage_knowledge/source_editor.py and equivalent triage_knowledge CLI operations

source.target_condition: Audible tailpipe hissing and hydrocarbon odour below set pressure
source.negative_condition: Certification-tag, register or visual-condition findings without passing evidence
source.test_informed_disclosure: The rule closely follows F-1002 wording and was revised after observing its first output. It is not independent evaluation knowledge.
source.semantic_conflict: The test reference frames F-1002 as suspected passing distinct from proven inability to relieve. The experimental rule classifies seat tightness itself as a confirmed failed required function.

first_release_observation.reason: The source text called itself an evaluation-only proposed policy. The model explicitly said it was not an activated assessment authority.
first_release_observation.correction: Experiment status stayed in publication and activation metadata; the domain source retained only the reviewed rule.

target_result.conclusion: The test-informed official KB edit had a repeatable effect on F-1002. L9 is also enforced by the existing confirmed-function-failure floor once the source reclassifies seat tightness as a failed required function.

negative_control.revised_rationales: One revised output explicitly cites the tag-only exclusion. The other preserves L2 and distinguishes the other valve without explicitly citing the rule.
negative_control.impact_limitation: Impact varied I7/I8 across baseline repeats and was I8/I8 after the edit; impact is not clean causal-isolation evidence.

stability.interpretation: Non-target model variance remains substantial. The rule text was sent in the shared full-batch context for all 21 findings. F-1005 was L10 in both baselines and L9 in every run containing either PSV rule revision; this possible side effect was not semantically resolved.

editor_scope_bug.observed: The pre-fix edit path replaced structured scopes and evidence with empty arrays, so release a39d... stored the amended item as general even though its prose contained a Scope line.
editor_scope_bug.fix: edit_item now deterministically re-extracts scopes, aliases and source evidence and rejects edits that extract to multiple items.
editor_scope_bug.delivery_limit: Restoring structured scope did not narrow provider delivery in the all-21 batch. Because the batch contains PSV findings, the scoped item is admitted to one batch-wide knowledge pool and appears in every finding assessment. Per-finding knowledge isolation is not implemented.

accounting.pricing_assumption: US$2/M input and US$10/M output without cache discount

aborted_wrong_scope_harness.reason: Stopped immediately after the owner corrected the experiment scope.

assessment.contract: pass for all four retained full-batch outputs
assessment.semantic: needs_review; calibrated 63-dimension reviews were not rerun
assessment.reason: The rule is synthetic, test-informed, conflicts with the test reference framing and lacks authenticated domain-owner approval; the study demonstrates delivery and influence, not engineering correctness.
assessment.working_candidate: Reset to the eight-item baseline release after the experiment.
assessment.current_activation: config/triage-activation-v12.json pins the unchanged baseline release with the fixed editor/retrieval implementation hash.
